description.en: Replaces the draw-off bits: each set bit hides one layer of the display. Read them first with CMND_GET_DRAW_OFF_BIT to change only some bits, and restore them afterwards. Bits (constants of ie4_ev_main.nut): OFF_RPG_CHARA 1, OFF_RPG_MAP 2, OFF_RPG_CAMERA 4, OFF_EVENT_CHARA 8, OFF_EVENT_MAP 16, OFF_MENU_CHARA 32, OFF_MENU_MAP 64, OFF_RPG_MINIMAP 128, OFF_EVENT_CHIBI 512; groups OFF_RPG, OFF_EVENT, OFF_MENU, OFF_ALL.

examples.case: Hiding the field during a skill scene (real usage, from ev42011800.nut)
